_doc: Sanctioned differences between frontend/ and frontend_mock/.
The contract (plans/doings/15_FRONTEND_MOCK_PARITY.md §0) is that the API layer
is the ONLY legitimate difference. Every entry here is either that, or a pending
decision recorded so the gate can catch NEW drift instead of drowning in old.
Adding a path here without a reason defeats the point of the gate.

reasons.vite.config.mts: THE sanctioned difference: /api proxied to the mock server on :8085.
reasons.package.json: Mock-only scripts (mock:api, test:control). Dependencies must still match exactly.
reasons.mock_api/**: The mock server itself, once split out of the single file (plan 15 A3).
reasons..ui-control-discovery.json: PENDING plan 15 F6 — unclear whether generated or committed.
reasons.README.md: Documents the mirror contract for the mock tree.
reasons.TEST_READY.md: Per-tree test status; independent by nature.
reasons.new-components/openwork/**: PENDING plan 15 Q2/C1 — does OpenWork ship into frontend/ or stay here?
reasons.shell/control/**: PENDING plan 15 Q2/C1. Also closes plan 13 Task 3 if it ships.
reasons.styles/openwork-dna.css: PENDING plan 15 Q2/C1. Imported by the mock's globals.css line 12.
reasons.public/ob-workers/*.js: Vendored OceanBase parser workers; absent from the mock, not UI.
